messages.subject: lavPredict with individual ordered data
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to predict a factor score for individual cases with lavPredict, but the data is ordered. It seems lavaan has a check  in the function if all the categories are present so of course, it seems this cannot be done then for an individual case?

Is there a workaround? Like some sort of dummy data or does anyone have n idea?

Thank you

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavPredict with individual ordered data
parts: Is there a workaround? Like some sort of dummy data

That's the workaround. Assuming all your items have the same response categories (e.g., 0 and 1), you could quickly make a data.frame that has all response categories:

dummyData <- data.frame(x1 = 0:1, x2 = 0:1, x3 = 0:1)

Then rbind() that to the bottom of your own newdata= so that all response categories are found.  It is only slightly more complicated if you have varying response categories, but still simple enough to make a dummyData with all observed categories.
